title: Functional significance and the gene dose effect

segs.text: Section two. Functional significance and the gene dose effect. An allele name is only useful once its functional significance is known, meaning what the variant does to the activity of the protein the gene codes for, whether an enzyme, a transporter or a receptor. Functional significance is about activity, not about how common the variant is. For these variants, labs have made the variant enzymes and measured their activity against the wild type, so genotype, the alleles, and phenotype, the activity, are tightly linked.

The same star number can mean different things in different genes. Star one is normal, wild type activity in both C Y P two C nineteen and C Y P two C nine. In C Y P two C nineteen, star two and star three have no activity. Both make a really short, truncated protein that does not function. In C Y P two C nine, star two and star three have decreased activity. So star two does not mean no activity in every gene.

Each person carries two alleles of each gene, one from each parent, and the pair is the genotype, written as C Y P two C nineteen star one, star two. Two different alleles make a person heterozygous, and two of the same make them homozygous. The activity of the two copies adds up. Star one, star one is normal, because both copies make active enzyme. Star one with star two, or star one with star three, is reduced, about halfway, because one copy makes active enzyme and the other makes none. She said, If you were to add it up, they look halfway in the range of two C nineteen activity. She called this the gene dose effect. There is no dominance in these drug-response variants.

Any pairing of the two inactive alleles, star two, star two, star two, star three, or star three, star three, has no activity. Being heterozygous does not by itself mean partial activity; star two, star three has none, because neither copy works. Someone homozygous for star three has no C Y P two C nineteen activity. Induction, raising the amount of enzyme with diet or other drugs, cannot rescue star two either, because the star two protein is too short to function.
